tools.name: foundry_products
tools.description: Free public discovery. Use {"view":"tasks","task":"exact_historical_evidence","subject":"postgresql"} to choose by historical task and held output, or {"view":"summary","limit":64} for the short offer index. Read {"product_id":"<exact listed ID>"} alone for the public contract before advertised sele

tools.name: foundry_selectors
tools.description: Discover exact held historical request parameters for a currently configured listed product. Free, no payment or purchased evidence; use next_cursor and exact filters. Currentness remains UNKNOWN.

tools.name: foundry_purchase
tools.description: Buy a configured public product by product_id and its exact business body. Generic clients receive a payment challenge; paying requires an external authorized client.

tools.name: foundry_purchase_read
tools.description: Read/recover this exact original purchase through existing HTTP READ authentication. Never signs or settles. Supply cursor for an existing result page.
